# Chalchitra

> Every Indian movie & series has a home. A structured catalogue of Indian movies and television series,
> launched with the class of 2026 (365 films, 60 series debuts,
> 2219 cast & crew profiles). Data derived from Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Catalogue sections:
- /movies — all 2026 Indian feature films, filterable by language
- /series — all 2026 Indian television & streaming series debuts
- /people — cast & crew profiles with credits, awards and full Wikipedia filmographies
- /search — full-text search over titles and people

Detail pages carry structured metadata as schema.org JSON-LD (Movie, TVSeries, Person)
plus canonical URLs. Content excerpts are attributed to their Wikipedia source articles
linked from every page.

The archive builds backward toward the 1950s, season by season. Each country gets its
own edition of this catalogue — a Korean edition is next — sharing the same
architecture, design and depth.

Site: https://chalachitra.example
